blockingFindings.title: The eleven promised domain types do not have a field-level or ownership contract
blockingFindings.requiredResolution: Add a compact object-contract matrix covering all eleven objects. For each, state the B1-owned minimum fields/invariants and validation expectation, or explicitly mark it C1-owned. Reconcile ActionDefinition with integration-boundaries.md Section 3.1; define ActionResult and ContinuationContext logical minimum without fixing physical transport; give Delivery, Change, Run, VerificationSummary, and OwnerAuthorizationRef enough field-level direction for Proposal and tests.

resolvedFindingsFromPriorRevisions.resolution: Action Catalog follows frozen core-model spec's ten formal Actions; change-checkpoint treated as Git boundary.
ResultRef is provider-neutral without mandatory runPath; concrete serialization deferred to C1.
Review focus item 4 updated to require ten Change Actions plus two Delivery Actions.
